## Problem

What real-world pain does this address? (Not "X is missing" — frame as the problem.)

## Proposed behaviour

How would it work from an operator's point of view?

## Alternatives considered

What's already there that doesn't cover this case?

## Out of scope

What this proposal is NOT trying to solve.
